hero.title: A Vite starter without the framework tax
hero.subtitle: Plain JavaScript templating, Tailwind CSS v4, i18next and Vitest — wired together and nothing more.

build.title: Vite build
build.body: Every *.html in the project root is a page. Hashed assets sorted by type, one vendor chunk, and a bundle report behind npm run analyze.

styles.title: Tailwind CSS v4
styles.body: Configured from CSS with @theme. No PostCSS chain, no Autoprefixer, no preprocessor to install.

i18n.title: i18next
i18n.body: Call t() in a template. The fallback language is bundled, so the first paint has real text.

quality.title: Quality gates
quality.body: ESLint, Prettier, type-checked JSDoc and Vitest run on every commit and in CI.

demo.hint: Change the state and the page re-renders — focus, caret and scroll position survive.
demo.label: Your name

about.title: Adding a page
about.body: This template is multi-page by default: no client-side router, no history API, just another HTML file.

steps.html: Copy index.html to blog.html and point its script at /src/blog.js.
steps.entry: Create src/blog.js and call startApp with the page content. There is no build config to edit.
